text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Urk... I messed up again... and this time, I
even
hurt myself.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
B-but it's not very serious, I deal with
this type of
injury every day. I'll be back
to training again in
no time.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Resting now will only set me back. The
gap
between me and everyone else will
grow wider.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
And... I just know I'll mess up again... So,
wh-what
if it becomes too late to catch
up?!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Oh, no, no, no! Please let me go back to
practice!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
There is some pain, but I can hardly feel
it!
choice_data_list: 無理をしないって約束できるなら

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Huh? W-wait, was that... a trick?!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Ohhh... I can't lie to you, Trainer. I'll rest
up for
today.

Meisho Doto crawls into bed, compliant
in her
road to recovery.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I w-won't! I'll wrap some gauze around it
just to be
safe!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
First, I do this... and then it should look
like this?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Th-the gauze is all tangled around
my legs!

With another injury to deal with, Meisho
Doto is
unable to return to training.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
T-Trainer, I'm sorry about this, but...
could you
help me?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Wow, it looks good! I c-can barely feel
the pain.

With the gauze wrapped perfectly in
place,
Meisho Doto is back to training!
